# `base/dropdown-menu`

Composing a menu anatomy — submenus, radio and checkbox items — from its parts.

## Selection

- **Use when:** Composing a menu anatomy — submenus, radio and checkbox items — from its parts.
- **Avoid when:** You want the assembled row-actions control, or the trigger is a right-click.
- **Consider instead:** `base/action-menu`, `base/context-menu`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { DropdownMenu } from "themelia-ui/base/dropdown-menu"
import "themelia-ui/base/dropdown-menu.css"
```

## Composition

This family has no component-family dependencies.

outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.
